title: Engineer's Screenshot
scenario: An engineer captured a screenshot shortly before unusual activity was reported. The image may contain information connected to the incident.
objective: Examine the provided screenshot and its metadata to identify the incident reference.
evidence: Fictional engineer screenshot (delivered by the CTF platform)

hints.t: Inspect information beyond the visible image content.
Direct your attention to file metadata and metadata-analysis tools.

title: Ticket 4721
scenario: A helpdesk ticket linked to INC-4721 contains information about maintenance activity near the time of the suspicious event.
objective: Locate and review Ticket 4721 and identify the maintenance window and account associated with the activity.
tools: Web browser, browser developer tools, page inspection

hints.t: Use the incident reference recovered from the previous stage.
Search for Ticket 4721 in the helpdesk system.
Review the maintenance-window and account details.

title: The 23:47 Event
scenario: A suspicious event occurred during the approved maintenance window and was recorded in fictional operations logs.
objective: Analyse the logs using the window and account from OS-02 to identify the suspicious 23:47 event.
tools: Text editor, grep, awk, standard Linux command-line tools
evidence: Synthetic operations-log files (delivered by the CTF platform)

hints.t: Focus on the approved maintenance window.
Search for activity associated with ops_readonly.

title: The Missing Packet
scenario: Suspicious network activity associated with the previously identified host and backup service is contained within a synthetic packet capture.
objective: Analyse the PCAP using the host and service from OS-03 to identify the relevant communication.
tools: Wireshark or Tshark, display filters, Follow TCP Stream

hints.t: Start with the host identified in OS-03.
Follow the stream associated with the backup service.

title: Backup Service
scenario: The account and disaster-recovery reference recovered from OS-04 point to an isolated backup-service environment.
objective: Use the recovered account and recovery reference to investigate the backup environment and identify the relevant node.
tools: Linux shell, grep, awk, cat, find
evidence: Isolated Linux container/VM with synthetic configuration, logs and records (restricted SSH)

hints.t: Use the recovery reference from OS-04.
Search the backup-service files for DR-2026-09.
Identify the node associated with the matching recovery record.

title: The Silent Mirror
scenario: NODE-03 contains the final synthetic investigation evidence linked to the complete Sentinel incident.
objective: Investigate NODE-03, correlate previously recovered clues, and reconstruct the complete incident.
tools: Linux shell, grep, find, cat, log-analysis tools, evidence from OS-01 to OS-05
evidence: Isolated final investigation container/VM representing NODE-03

hints.t: Review the evidence collected from earlier stages.
Focus on artifacts linked to NODE-03.
Correlate the incident, account, host, service, recovery reference and node information.
